name: ssh_remote
description: Run commands on a named remote host over SSH. Use for 'ssh into vps2 and check disk space', 'update apt packages on vps2', 'run docker ps on vps2', or 'test ssh connection to vps2'. Actions: list_hosts, test, run, apt_update, multi.

action.description: Action: 'list_hosts' (show hosts), 'test' (test connection), 'run' (execute command), 'apt_update' (apt update/upgrade), 'multi' (multiple commands)

host.description: Named host alias (e.g., 'vps2'). Required for test, run, apt_update, multi.

command.description: Command to execute on remote host (for 'run' action)

commands.description: List of commands to execute in sequence (for 'multi' action)

sudo.description: Run command(s) with sudo when the host has a sudo password configured

upgrade.description: For apt_update: also run apt upgrade -y (default: true)

stop_on_error.description: For multi: stop if a command fails (default: true)

output_limit.description: Max output lines to return (default: 150 from config)

availability.setup_hint: Copy config/ssh.json.example to config/ssh.json and configure host aliases. SSH key paths inside the file are resolved at runtime.
